description: Numerical substitution for an original free name is correct even when the formula and replacement term also contain auxiliary names.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.mixed_substitution_correct.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (S : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.EffectiveSignature L) {n : ℕ} (a : L.BoundedFormula (ℕ ⊕ ℕ) n) (i : ℕ)
  (t : L.Term (ℕ ⊕ ℕ)) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.substitute S n (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.mixedCode S a) i
      (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.termCode S
        (Sum.elim Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.freeName Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.auxName)
        t) =
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.mixedCode S
      (a.subst fun j => if j = Sum.inl i then t else FirstOrder.Language.var j)
